title: Stuck on collecting inital readings screen while connecting to Bluecon
symptom: On data collector running. In logs only Error code 1(sqlite_error), error or missing database. The app gets stuck on the screen that says it needs 2 readings while connecting to Bluecon.
cause: The issue may be caused by the Blucon being paired with an iPhone when trying to use it with an Android phone, or by not waiting long enough for the two readings (which take 10 minutes).
fix: Make sure your Blucon is not paired with your iPhone when trying with android phone, so delete pairing. Wait enough time for the 2 values (10 minutes).
evidence_quote: make sure your Blucon is not paired with your iPhone when trying with android phone. so delete pairing. 2 values need 10minutes so you need to wait enough.
